questions.text: Describe the difference between a citizen and foreigner.
questions.text_as_printed: Describe the difference between a citizen and foreigner. (A)

answer.value:
Differences between a Citizen and a Foreigner:
A citizen is a permanent resident of a country, while a foreigner is a temporary resident.
Citizens have political rights, which foreigners do not.
A citizen is loyal to their country, while a foreigner is loyal to their own nation.
Foreigners can be deported for illegal activities, but citizens cannot be ordered to leave.
Citizens enjoy the full rights and responsibilities, while foreigners have limited rights.
